name: speed-lines
title: Speed Lines
description: Emphasis lines drawn in SVG at the real size: focus (radial concentration lines with an empty centre and a movable origin) or motion (tapered parallel lines at any direction). Density control, optional stepped animation (off with reduced motion). Children sit on top with a paper knockout, ideal for SFX.

meta.tagline: Focus or motion lines to make a moment hit.
meta.usage: import { SpeedLines } from "@/components/manga/speed-lines" ドン!

props.name: animated
props.description: Redraws the lines in steps: true ≈ 6 fps, "slow" ≈ 2 fps. Off with reduced motion.

props.name: seed
props.description: Changes the irregularity of the lines.
